text: Landed in the commit before this reply. test_designer has stand_in_installers(test, *names): a folder of the test holding an executable that does nothing for each installer named, put first on os.environ's PATH for the length of the test and restored by a cleanup. The build, S6 (gate.clean_env copies os.environ) and the copy's runner all see it. ExecutionPermission and ValidatedInItsEnvironment call it for pixi in setUp; no adapter calls it. Reproduced first: with every PATH folder that holds a pixi removed and Python called by its absolute path, Ran 301, FAILED (failures=3), the three you named. After: Ran 301, OK without pixi on PATH and Ran 301, OK with it. test_template_v11's missing-installer test sets its own PATH and is unchanged. contracts/tests 116 OK. CI goes green once this is pushed, on the person's word.
